+      ⟨atom_subst classical rel rel_L rel_R x y i j,
+       atom_subst_rev classical eq_symm rel rel_L rel_R x y i j⟩
+  | NF.eq _ _, _, hf => hf.elim
+  | NF.bot, _, _ => ⟨ded2 classical h0, ded2 classical h0⟩
+  | imp a b, hq, hf => by
+      have ha := leibniz x y a hq.1 hf.1
+      have hb := leibniz x y b hq.2 hf.2
+      constructor
+      · apply ded3 classical
+        have a0 : Der NF.imp (ThmK Ax) [rn x y a, imp a b, NF.eq x y] a :=
+          .mp (.mp (.ax ha.2) h2) h0
+        exact .mp (.mp (.ax hb.1) h2) (.mp h1 a0)
+      · apply ded3 classical
+        have a0 : Der NF.imp (ThmK Ax) [a, imp (rn x y a) (rn x y b), NF.eq x y] (rn x y a) :=
+          .mp (.mp (.ax ha.1) h2) h0
+        exact .mp (.mp (.ax hb.2) h2) (.mp h1 a0)
+  | all _ _, hq, _ => hq.elim
+
+theorem qf_bound {n : Nat} : ∀ {f : NF}, QF f → ¬ Bound n f
+  | rel _ _, _ => id
+  | NF.eq _ _, _ => id
+  | NF.bot, _ => id
+  | imp _ _, h => fun b => b.elim (qf_bound h.1) (qf_bound h.2)
+  | all _ _, h => h.elim
+
+/-- Specialization `∀x φ → φ[y/x]` for quantifier-free, equality-free `φ`. -/
+theorem spec {x y : Nat} (hxy : y ≠ x) {f : NF} (hq : QF f) (hf : EqFree f) :
+    ThmK Ax (imp (all x f) (rn x y f)) := by
+  have L := (leibniz (Ax := Ax) x y f hq hf).1
+  have shuffle : ThmK Ax (imp f (imp (NF.eq x y) (rn x y f))) :=
+    ded2 classical (.mp (.mp (.ax L) h0) h1)
+  have g : ThmK Ax (imp (all x f) (all x (imp (NF.eq x y) (rn x y f)))) :=
+    all_mono classical x shuffle
+  have e : ThmK Ax (imp (all x (imp (NF.eq x y) (rn x y f)))
+      (imp (ex x (NF.eq x y)) (ex x (rn x y f)))) := all_imp_ex classical x _ _
+  have elim : ThmK Ax (imp (ex x (rn x y f)) (rn x y f)) :=
+    ex_elim x (eqFree_rn x y f hf) (not_occurs_rn hxy f (qf_bound hq))
+  apply ded1 classical
+  exact .mp (.ax elim) (.mp (.mp (.ax e) (.mp (.ax g) h0)) (.ax (.rho1 x y)))
+
+/-- Alpha-renaming of a binder to a fresh label, both directions. -/
+theorem alpha_fwd {x y : Nat} (hxy : y ≠ x) {f : NF} (hq : QF f) (hf : EqFree f)
+    (hy : ¬ Occurs y f) : ThmK Ax (imp (all x f) (all y (rn x y f))) := by
+  have hyo : ¬ Occurs y (all x f) := by
+    simp only [Occurs]; intro o; cases o with
+    | inl o => exact hxy o
+    | inr o => exact hy o
+  exact syl classical (vac_of_not_occurs y _ hf hyo) (all_mono classical y (spec hxy hq hf))
+
+theorem qf_rn (x y : Nat) : ∀ f : NF, QF f → QF (rn x y f)
+  | rel _ _, _ => trivial
+  | NF.eq _ _, _ => trivial
+  | NF.bot, _ => trivial
+  | imp a b, h => ⟨qf_rn x y a h.1, qf_rn x y b h.2⟩
+  | all _ _, h => h.elim
+
+theorem alpha_bwd {x y : Nat} (hxy : y ≠ x) {f : NF} (hq : QF f) (hf : EqFree f)
+    (hy : ¬ Occurs y f) : ThmK Ax (imp (all y (rn x y f)) (all x f)) := by
+  have s : ThmK Ax (imp (all y (rn x y f)) (rn y x (rn x y f))) :=
+    spec (Ne.symm hxy) (qf_rn x y f hq) (eqFree_rn x y f hf)
+  rw [rn_rn_fresh f hy] at s
+  have hxo : ¬ Occurs x (all y (rn x y f)) := by
+    simp only [Occurs]; intro o; cases o with
+    | inl o => exact hxy o.symm
+    | inr o => exact not_occurs_rn hxy f (qf_bound hq) o
+  exact syl classical (vac_of_not_occurs x _ (eqFree_rn x y f hf) hxo) (all_mono classical x s)
+
+#print axioms spec
+#print axioms alpha_bwd
+
+end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KThmK

+import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Kalmar
+import BusyBeaver.ZFC.TarskiCalculus
+
+/-!
+Derived rules of the machines' Tarski calculus.
+
+The propositional and quantifier rules below hold for any theorem predicate `T`
+that is classical for `imp`/`bot` (`hC`: K, S, Peirce and ex falso under MP) and,
+for the quantifier rules, has the rows of `Rows` (generalization, rho1–rho7 and
+atomic membership vacuity). Both the Tarski calculus `Thm` and the restricted
+calculus `KThmK.ThmK` are instances, so these proofs are shared. `Lukasiewicz.lean`
+and `Tarski.classical` discharge `hC` from the row `rho8` alone; keeping it
+abstract here separates the propositional search certificates from the
+quantifier argument.
+
+Main results:
+
+* `vac_of_not_occurs`: `φ → ∀i φ` for every formula in which the label `i`
+  does not occur. The calculus only has this for atoms (gated by `c ≠ a, b`);
+  the general schema follows from distribution, commutation and `rho6`.
+* `ex_elim_of_vac`: `∃i φ → φ` whenever `φ → ∀i φ` is a theorem.
+* `eq_refl`, `eq_symm`, `eq_trans`: equality is an equivalence relation,
+  obtained from `rho1`, `rho7` and atomic vacuity.
+-/
+
+namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Tarski
+
+open NF Kalmar
+
+/-- The quantifier and atomic rows shared by `Thm` and the restricted calculus `ThmK`
+(everything but equality vacuity, which the two calculi grant at different binders). -/
+class Rows (T : NF → Prop) : Prop where
+  gen (i : Nat) {a : NF} : T a → T (all i a)
+  rho2 (i : Nat) (b c : NF) : T (imp (all i (imp b c)) (imp (all i b) (all i c)))
+  rho4 (i j : Nat) (c : NF) : T (imp (all i (all j c)) (all j (all i c)))
+  rho6 (i : Nat) (b : NF) : T (imp (ex i (all i b)) b)
+  rho1 (i j : Nat) : T (ex i (NF.eq i j))
+  rho7 (a b c : Nat) : T (imp (NF.eq c a) (imp (NF.eq c b) (NF.eq a b)))
+  rho5 (a b c : Nat) : T (imp (NF.eq c a) (imp (rel c b) (rel a b)))
+  rho3 (a b c : Nat) : T (imp (NF.eq a b) (imp (rel c a) (rel c b)))
+  vacRel (a b c : Nat) : c ≠ a → c ≠ b → T (imp (rel a b) (all c (rel a b)))
+
+instance {Ax : NF → Prop} : Rows (Thm Ax) where
+  gen := .gen
+  rho2 := .rho2
+  rho4 := .rho4
+  rho6 := .rho6
+  rho1 := .rho1
+  rho7 := .rho7
+  rho5 := .rho5
+  rho3 := .rho3
+  vacRel := .vacRel
+
+variable {Ax : NF → Prop} {T : NF → Prop}
+
+/-- Hypothesis `k` of a list, as a derivation. -/
+theorem h0 {G : List NF} {a : NF} : Der NF.imp T (a :: G) a := .hyp (List.mem_cons_self ..)
+theorem h1 {G : List NF} {a b : NF} : Der NF.imp T (b :: a :: G) a :=
+  .hyp (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self ..))
+theorem h2 {G : List NF} {a b c : NF} : Der NF.imp T (c :: b :: a :: G) a :=
+  .hyp (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)))
+
+section PropLayer
+
+variable (hC : Classical NF.imp NF.bot T)
+include hC
+
+/-- Derivations from hypotheses discharge into theorems. -/
+theorem of_der {G : List NF} {a : NF} (d : Der NF.imp T G a)
+    (hG : ∀ x, x ∈ G → T x) : T a :=
+  d.sound hC hG
+
+theorem thm_of_der0 {a : NF} (d : Der NF.imp T [] a) : T a :=
+  of_der hC d (fun _ hx => absurd hx List.not_mem_nil)
+
+/-- Two-hypothesis deduction. -/
+theorem ded2 {a b c : NF} (d : Der NF.imp T [b, a] c) : T (imp a (imp b c)) :=
+  thm_of_der0 hC (deduction hC (deduction hC d))
+
+theorem ded1 {a c : NF} (d : Der NF.imp T [a] c) : T (imp a c) :=
+  thm_of_der0 hC (deduction hC d)
+
+theorem ded3 {a b c d : NF} (dd : Der NF.imp T [c, b, a] d) :
+    T (imp a (imp b (imp c d))) :=
+  thm_of_der0 hC (deduction hC (deduction hC (deduction hC dd)))
+
+theorem syl {a b c : NF} (hab : T (imp a b)) (hbc : T (imp b c)) : T (imp a c) :=
+  ded1 hC (.mp (.ax hbc) (.mp (.ax hab) h0))
+
+/-- `(a → b) → (¬b → ¬a)` -/
+theorem contra_thm (a b : NF) : T (imp (imp a b) (imp (neg b) (neg a))) :=
+  ded3 hC (.mp h1 (.mp h2 h0))
+
+theorem contra {a b : NF} (h : T (imp a b)) : T (imp (neg b) (neg a)) :=
+  hC.mp (contra_thm hC a b) h
+
+theorem dne (a : NF) : T (imp (neg (neg a)) a) := by
+  -- Peirce at `bot`: from `¬a → a`, which `¬¬a` and ex falso supply.
+  apply ded1 hC
+  have inner : Der NF.imp T [neg (neg a)] (imp (imp a NF.bot) a) :=
+    deduction hC (.mp (.ax (hC.efq a)) (.mp h1 h0))
+  exact .mp (.ax (hC.peirce a NF.bot)) inner
+
+theorem dni (a : NF) : T (imp a (neg (neg a))) :=
+  ded2 hC (.mp h0 h1)
+
+/-- Classical contraposition in the reverse direction. -/
+theorem contra_rev {a b : NF} (h : T (imp (neg a) (neg b))) : T (imp b a) := by
+  have h' := contra hC h
+  exact syl hC (syl hC (dni hC b) h') (dne hC a)
+
+/-- Case split: `(¬a → c) → ((b → c) → ((a → b) → c))`. -/
+theorem imp_cases (a b c : NF) :
+    T (imp (imp (neg a) c) (imp (imp b c) (imp (imp a b) c))) := by
+  apply ded3 hC
+  -- hypotheses: (¬a → c), (b → c), (a → b); goal c, by Peirce at bot on c.
+  have inner : Der NF.imp T [neg c, imp a b, imp b c, imp (neg a) c] c := by
+    have na : Der NF.imp T [neg c, imp a b, imp b c, imp (neg a) c] (neg a) :=
+      deduction hC (.mp (Der.hyp (a := neg c) (by simp))
+        (.mp (Der.hyp (a := imp b c) (by simp)) (.mp (Der.hyp (a := imp a b) (by simp)) h0)))
+    exact .mp (Der.hyp (a := imp (neg a) c) (by simp)) na
+  exact .mp (.ax (hC.peirce c NF.bot)) (deduction hC inner)
+
+theorem vac_bot (i : Nat) : T (imp NF.bot (all i NF.bot)) := hC.efq _
+
+end PropLayer

+theorem all_mono (i : Nat) {a b : NF} (h : T (imp a b)) : T (imp (all i a) (all i b)) :=
+  hC.mp (R.rho2 i a b) (R.gen i h)

+theorem ex_mono (i : Nat) {a b : NF} (h : T (imp a b)) : T (imp (ex i a) (ex i b)) :=
+  contra hC (all_mono hC i (contra hC h))

+  syl hC (ex_mono hC i h) (R.rho6 i a)

+  syl hC (all_mono hC j ha) (R.rho4 j i a)

+section Fresh

+variable (hC : Classical NF.imp NF.bot (Thm Ax))

+/-- Vacuity for every formula not containing the label. -/
+theorem vac_of_not_occurs (i : Nat) :

+/-- `∃i a → a` when `i` does not occur in `a`. -/
+theorem ex_elim (i : Nat) {a : NF} (h : ¬ Occurs i a) : Thm Ax (imp (ex i a) a) :=
+  ex_elim_of_vac hC (vac_of_not_occurs hC i a h)
+
+/-! ## Equality is an equivalence relation -/

+theorem eq_refl (x : Nat) : Thm Ax (NF.eq x x) := by
+  -- Choose a label `c` different from `x`; `rho1` gives `∃c (c = x)`.
+  have h7 : Thm Ax (imp (NF.eq (x + 1) x) (NF.eq x x)) := by

+    simp only [Occurs]; omega
+  exact hC.mp (ex_elim hC (x + 1) hno) hex

+import BusyBeaver.ZFC.TarskiDerived
+
+/-!
+Substitution inside the substitution-free Tarski calculus.
+
+The machine calculus has no substitution operation and no specialization
+row `∀x φ → φ[y/x]`. This module shows the rows nevertheless derive:
+
+* `leibniz`: `x = y → (φ ↔ φ[y/x])` for every formula in which neither label
+  is rebound, from the three atomic congruence rows `rho3`, `rho5`, `rho7`;
+* `spec`: `∀x φ → φ[y/x]` (specialization), using `rho1 : ∃x (x = y)`;
+* `spec_self`: `∀x φ → φ` (the T axiom), via a fresh detour label;
+* `alpha_fwd`/`alpha_bwd`: renaming a bound label to a fresh one.
+
+`rn x y φ` replaces the free occurrences of `x` by `y`. The side condition
+"neither label is bound in `φ`" excludes capture; arbitrary formulas are
+brought into that shape by `alpha` in the completeness proof.
+-/
+
+namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Tarski
+
+open NF Kalmar
+
+/-! ## Renaming of free occurrences -/
+
+def rv (x y n : Nat) : Nat := if n = x then y else n
+
+/-- Replace the free occurrences of `x` by `y`. -/
+def rn (x y : Nat) : NF → NF
+  | rel i j => rel (rv x y i) (rv x y j)
+  | NF.eq i j => NF.eq (rv x y i) (rv x y j)
+  | NF.bot => NF.bot
+  | imp a b => imp (rn x y a) (rn x y b)
+  | all i a => if i = x then all i a else all i (rn x y a)
+
+/-- The label is used as a binder somewhere. -/
+def Bound (n : Nat) : NF → Prop
+  | rel _ _ => False
+  | NF.eq _ _ => False
+  | NF.bot => False
+  | imp a b => Bound n a ∨ Bound n b
+  | all i a => n = i ∨ Bound n a
+
+theorem bound_rn (x y n : Nat) : ∀ f : NF, Bound n (rn x y f) ↔ Bound n f
+  | rel _ _ => Iff.rfl
+  | NF.eq _ _ => Iff.rfl
+  | NF.bot => Iff.rfl
+  | imp a b => by simp only [rn, Bound, bound_rn x y n a, bound_rn x y n b]
+  | all i a => by
+      by_cases h : i = x
+      · simp only [rn, h, if_true]
+      · simp only [rn, h, if_false, Bound, bound_rn x y n a]
+
+theorem bound_occurs {n : Nat} : ∀ {f : NF}, Bound n f → Occurs n f
+  | imp _ _, h => h.elim (fun h => Or.inl (bound_occurs h)) (fun h => Or.inr (bound_occurs h))
+  | all _ _, h => h.elim Or.inl (fun h => Or.inr (bound_occurs h))
+
+/-- After renaming `x` away, `x` no longer occurs (if it was not a binder). -/
+theorem not_occurs_rn {x y : Nat} (hxy : y ≠ x) :
+    ∀ f : NF, ¬ Bound x f → ¬ Occurs x (rn x y f)
+  | rel i j, _ => by
+      simp only [rn, Occurs, rv]
+      by_cases hi : i = x <;> by_cases hj : j = x <;> simp [hi, hj] <;> omega
+  | NF.eq i j, _ => by
+      simp only [rn, Occurs, rv]
+      by_cases hi : i = x <;> by_cases hj : j = x <;> simp [hi, hj] <;> omega
+  | NF.bot, _ => id
+  | imp a b, hb => by
+      simp only [rn, Occurs]
+      intro h
+      cases h with
+      | inl h => exact not_occurs_rn hxy a (fun h' => hb (Or.inl h')) h
+      | inr h => exact not_occurs_rn hxy b (fun h' => hb (Or.inr h')) h
+  | all i a, hb => by
+      have hix : i ≠ x := fun e => hb (Or.inl e.symm)
+      simp only [rn, hix, if_false, Occurs]
+      intro h
+      cases h with
+      | inl h => exact hix h.symm
+      | inr h => exact not_occurs_rn hxy a (fun h' => hb (Or.inr h')) h
+
+/-- Labels other than `x` and `y` occur after renaming iff they occurred before. -/
+theorem occurs_rn_of_ne {x y n : Nat} (hx : n ≠ x) (hy : n ≠ y) :
+    ∀ f : NF, Occurs n (rn x y f) ↔ Occurs n f
+  | rel i j => by
+      simp only [rn, Occurs, rv]
+      by_cases hi : i = x <;> by_cases hj : j = x <;> simp [hi, hj] <;> omega
+  | NF.eq i j => by
+      simp only [rn, Occurs, rv]
+      by_cases hi : i = x <;> by_cases hj : j = x <;> simp [hi, hj] <;> omega
+  | NF.bot => Iff.rfl
+  | imp a b => by simp only [rn, Occurs, occurs_rn_of_ne hx hy a, occurs_rn_of_ne hx hy b]
+  | all i a => by
+      by_cases h : i = x
+      · simp only [rn, h, if_true]
+      · simp only [rn, h, if_false, Occurs, occurs_rn_of_ne hx hy a]
+
+theorem rn_not_occurs {x y : Nat} : ∀ f : NF, ¬ Occurs x f → rn x y f = f
+  | rel i j, h => by
+      simp only [Occurs] at h
+      simp only [rn, rv]
+      have hi : i ≠ x := fun e => h (Or.inl e.symm)
+      have hj : j ≠ x := fun e => h (Or.inr e.symm)
+      simp [hi, hj]
+  | NF.eq i j, h => by
+      simp only [Occurs] at h
+      simp only [rn, rv]
+      have hi : i ≠ x := fun e => h (Or.inl e.symm)
+      have hj : j ≠ x := fun e => h (Or.inr e.symm)
+      simp [hi, hj]
+  | NF.bot, _ => rfl
+  | imp a b, h => by
+      simp only [rn, rn_not_occurs a (fun o => h (Or.inl o)), rn_not_occurs b (fun o => h (Or.inr o))]
+  | all i a, h => by
+      have hix : i ≠ x := fun e => h (Or.inl e.symm)
+      simp only [rn, hix, if_false, rn_not_occurs a (fun o => h (Or.inr o))]
+
+/-- Renaming back through a fresh label is the identity. -/
+theorem rn_rn_fresh {x z : Nat} : ∀ f : NF, ¬ Occurs z f → rn z x (rn x z f) = f
+  | rel i j, h => by
+      simp only [Occurs] at h
+      simp only [rn, rv]
+      by_cases hi : i = x <;> by_cases hj : j = x <;> simp [hi, hj] <;> omega
+  | NF.eq i j, h => by
+      simp only [Occurs] at h
+      simp only [rn, rv]
+      by_cases hi : i = x <;> by_cases hj : j = x <;> simp [hi, hj] <;> omega
+  | NF.bot, _ => rfl
+  | imp a b, h => by
+      simp only [rn, rn_rn_fresh a (fun o => h (Or.inl o)), rn_rn_fresh b (fun o => h (Or.inr o))]
+  | all i a, h => by
+      have hiz : z ≠ i := fun e => h (Or.inl e)
+      by_cases hix : i = x
+      · rw [show rn x z (all i a) = all i a by simp [rn, hix]]
+        simp [rn, Ne.symm hiz, rn_not_occurs a (fun o => h (Or.inr o))]
+      · simp only [rn, hix, if_false, Ne.symm hiz, if_false, rn_rn_fresh a (fun o => h (Or.inr o))]
+
+theorem rn_self (x : Nat) : ∀ f : NF, rn x x f = f
+  | rel i j => by simp only [rn, rv]; by_cases hi : i = x <;> by_cases hj : j = x <;> simp [hi, hj]
+  | NF.eq i j => by simp only [rn, rv]; by_cases hi : i = x <;> by_cases hj : j = x <;> simp [hi, hj]
+  | NF.bot => rfl
+  | imp a b => by simp only [rn, rn_self x a, rn_self x b]
+  | all i a => by by_cases h : i = x <;> simp [rn, h, rn_self x a]
+
+/-! ## Leibniz's law -/
+
+variable {Ax : NF → Prop} {T : NF → Prop}
+
+theorem rel_L [R : Rows T] (u v j : Nat) : T (imp (NF.eq u v) (imp (rel u j) (rel v j))) :=
+  R.rho5 v j u
+theorem rel_R [R : Rows T] (u v i : Nat) : T (imp (NF.eq u v) (imp (rel i u) (rel i v))) :=
+  R.rho3 u v i
+
+theorem eq_L [R : Rows T] (u v j : Nat) : T (imp (NF.eq u v) (imp (NF.eq u j) (NF.eq v j))) :=
+  -- rho7: u = v → (u = j → v = j)
+  R.rho7 v j u
+
+
+/-- A label strictly above every label of a formula. -/
+def top : NF → Nat
+  | rel i j => max i j + 1
+  | NF.eq i j => max i j + 1
+  | NF.bot => 0
+  | imp a b => max (top a) (top b)
+  | all i a => max (i + 1) (top a)
+
+theorem not_occurs_of_top_le {n : Nat} : ∀ {f : NF}, top f ≤ n → ¬ Occurs n f
+  | rel i j, h => by simp only [top] at h; simp only [Occurs]; omega
+  | NF.eq i j, h => by simp only [top] at h; simp only [Occurs]; omega
+  | NF.bot, _ => id
+  | imp a b, h => by
+      simp only [top] at h
+      simp only [Occurs]
+      intro o
+      cases o with
+      | inl o => exact not_occurs_of_top_le (by omega) o
+      | inr o => exact not_occurs_of_top_le (by omega) o
+  | all i a, h => by
+      simp only [top] at h
+      simp only [Occurs]
+      intro o
+      cases o with
+      | inl o => omega
+      | inr o => exact not_occurs_of_top_le (by omega) o
+
+section Atoms
+
+variable (hC : Classical NF.imp NF.bot T)
+include hC
+
+/-- Rewriting both places of a two-place atom along `x = y`. -/
+theorem atom_subst (P : Nat → Nat → NF)
+    (hL : ∀ u v j, T (imp (NF.eq u v) (imp (P u j) (P v j))))
+    (hR : ∀ u v i, T (imp (NF.eq u v) (imp (P i u) (P i v))))
+    (x y i j : Nat) : T (imp (NF.eq x y) (imp (P i j) (P (rv x y i) (rv x y j)))) := by
+  have step1 : T (imp (NF.eq x y) (imp (P i j) (P (rv x y i) j))) := by
+    by_cases hi : i = x
+    · subst hi; simp only [rv, if_true]; exact hL i y j
+    · simp only [rv, hi, if_false]; exact ded2 hC h0
+  have step2 : T (imp (NF.eq x y) (imp (P (rv x y i) j) (P (rv x y i) (rv x y j)))) := by
+    by_cases hj : j = x
+    · subst hj; simp only [rv, if_true]; exact hR j y _
+    · simp only [rv, hj, if_false]; exact ded2 hC h0
+  apply ded2 hC
+  exact .mp (.mp (.ax step2) h1) (.mp (.mp (.ax step1) h1) h0)
+
+/-- The reverse rewriting, through symmetry of equality (`hs`). -/
+theorem atom_subst_rev (hs : ∀ x y, T (imp (NF.eq x y) (NF.eq y x))) (P : Nat → Nat → NF)
+    (hL : ∀ u v j, T (imp (NF.eq u v) (imp (P u j) (P v j))))
+    (hR : ∀ u v i, T (imp (NF.eq u v) (imp (P i u) (P i v))))
+    (x y i j : Nat) : T (imp (NF.eq x y) (imp (P (rv x y i) (rv x y j)) (P i j))) := by
+  have step1 : T (imp (NF.eq y x) (imp (P (rv x y i) (rv x y j)) (P i (rv x y j)))) := by
+    by_cases hi : i = x
+    · subst hi; simp only [rv, if_true]; exact hL y i _
+    · simp only [rv, hi, if_false]; exact ded2 hC h0
+  have step2 : T (imp (NF.eq y x) (imp (P i (rv x y j)) (P i j))) := by
+    by_cases hj : j = x
+    · subst hj; simp only [rv, if_true]; exact hR y j i
+    · simp only [rv, hj, if_false]; exact ded2 hC h0
+  apply ded2 hC
+  have hyx : Der NF.imp T [P (rv x y i) (rv x y j), NF.eq x y] (NF.eq y x) :=
+    .mp (.ax (hs x y)) h1
+  exact .mp (.mp (.ax step2) hyx) (.mp (.mp (.ax step1) hyx) h0)
+
+/-- Object-level existential monotonicity: `∀i(a → b) → (∃i a → ∃i b)`. -/
+theorem all_imp_ex [R : Rows T] (i : Nat) (a b : NF) :
+    T (imp (all i (imp a b)) (imp (ex i a) (ex i b))) := by
+  have c1 : T (imp (all i (imp a b)) (all i (imp (neg b) (neg a)))) :=
+    all_mono hC i (contra_thm hC a b)
+  -- ∀i(a→b) → (∀i¬b → ∀i¬a), then contrapose the inner implication.
+  have c3 : T (imp (all i (imp a b)) (imp (all i (neg b)) (all i (neg a)))) :=
+    syl hC c1 (R.rho2 i (neg b) (neg a))
+  apply ded2 hC
+  -- hypotheses: ∀i(a→b), ∃i a = ¬∀i¬a; goal ∃i b = ¬∀i¬b
+  apply deduction hC
+  exact .mp h1 (.mp (.mp (.ax c3) h2) h0)
+
+end Atoms
+
+section Leibniz
+
+variable (hC : Classical NF.imp NF.bot (Thm Ax))
+include hC

+theorem eq_R (u v i : Nat) : Thm Ax (imp (NF.eq u v) (imp (NF.eq i u) (NF.eq i v))) := by
+  apply ded2 hC
+  exact .mp (.mp (.ax (eq_trans hC i u v)) h0) h1
+
+/-- Leibniz's law for formulas without rebinding of either label. -/
+theorem leibniz (x y : Nat) :
+    ∀ f : NF, ¬ Bound x f → ¬ Bound y f →
+      Thm Ax (imp (NF.eq x y) (imp f (rn x y f))) ∧
+      Thm Ax (imp (NF.eq x y) (imp (rn x y f) f))
+  | rel i j, _, _ =>
+      ⟨atom_subst hC rel (rel_L (T := Thm Ax)) (rel_R (T := Thm Ax)) x y i j,
+       atom_subst_rev hC (eq_symm hC) rel (rel_L (T := Thm Ax)) (rel_R (T := Thm Ax)) x y i j⟩
+  | NF.eq i j, _, _ =>
+      ⟨atom_subst hC NF.eq (eq_L (T := Thm Ax)) (eq_R hC) x y i j,
+       atom_subst_rev hC (eq_symm hC) NF.eq (eq_L (T := Thm Ax)) (eq_R hC) x y i j⟩
+  | NF.bot, _, _ => ⟨ded2 hC h0, ded2 hC h0⟩
+  | imp a b, hx, hy => by
+      have ha := leibniz x y a (fun h => hx (Or.inl h)) (fun h => hy (Or.inl h))
+      have hb := leibniz x y b (fun h => hx (Or.inr h)) (fun h => hy (Or.inr h))
+      constructor
+      · apply ded3 hC
+        -- hypotheses: x = y, a → b, a'; goal b'
+        have a0 : Der NF.imp (Thm Ax) [rn x y a, imp a b, NF.eq x y] a :=
+          .mp (.mp (.ax ha.2) h2) h0
+        exact .mp (.mp (.ax hb.1) h2) (.mp h1 a0)
+      · apply ded3 hC
+        have a0 : Der NF.imp (Thm Ax) [a, imp (rn x y a) (rn x y b), NF.eq x y] (rn x y a) :=
+          .mp (.mp (.ax ha.1) h2) h0
+        exact .mp (.mp (.ax hb.2) h2) (.mp h1 a0)
+  | all i a, hx, hy => by
+      have hix : i ≠ x := fun e => hx (Or.inl e.symm)
+      have hiy : i ≠ y := fun e => hy (Or.inl e.symm)
+      have ha := leibniz x y a (fun h => hx (Or.inr h)) (fun h => hy (Or.inr h))

+        intro p q h
+        have g : Thm Ax (imp (all i (NF.eq x y)) (all i (imp p q))) := all_mono hC i h
+        have v : Thm Ax (imp (NF.eq x y) (all i (NF.eq x y))) :=
+          .vacEq x y i hix hiy
+        apply ded2 hC
+        exact .mp (.mp (.ax (.rho2 i p q)) (.mp (.ax g) (.mp (.ax v) h1))) h0
+      exact ⟨lift ha.1, lift ha.2⟩
+
+/-! ## Specialization and alpha-renaming -/
+
+/-- Specialization: `∀x φ → φ[y/x]` when neither label is rebound and `y ≠ x`. -/
+theorem spec {x y : Nat} (hxy : y ≠ x) {f : NF} (hx : ¬ Bound x f) (hy : ¬ Bound y f) :
+    Thm Ax (imp (all x f) (rn x y f)) := by
+  have L := (leibniz hC x y f hx hy).1
+  -- ∀x(x = y → f') from ∀x f
+  have shuffle : Thm Ax (imp f (imp (NF.eq x y) (rn x y f))) :=
+    ded2 hC (.mp (.mp (.ax L) h0) h1)
+  have g : Thm Ax (imp (all x f) (all x (imp (NF.eq x y) (rn x y f)))) := all_mono hC x shuffle
+  have e : Thm Ax (imp (all x (imp (NF.eq x y) (rn x y f))) (imp (ex x (NF.eq x y)) (ex x (rn x y f)))) :=
+    all_imp_ex hC x _ _
+  have elim : Thm Ax (imp (ex x (rn x y f)) (rn x y f)) :=
+    ex_elim hC x (not_occurs_rn hxy f hx)
+  apply ded1 hC
+  exact .mp (.ax elim) (.mp (.mp (.ax e) (.mp (.ax g) h0)) (.ax (.rho1 x y)))
+
+/-- The T axiom `∀x φ → φ`, for `φ` without rebinding of `x`. -/
+theorem spec_self {x : Nat} {f : NF} (hx : ¬ Bound x f) : Thm Ax (imp (all x f) f) := by
+  let z := max (top f) (x + 1)
+  have hz : ¬ Occurs z f := not_occurs_of_top_le (by omega)
+  have hzx : z ≠ x := by omega
+  have hzb : ¬ Bound z f := fun b => hz (bound_occurs b)
+  -- ∀x f → f[z/x]
+  have s1 : Thm Ax (imp (all x f) (rn x z f)) := spec hC hzx hx hzb
+  -- ∀x f → ∀z ∀x f → ∀z f[z/x]
+  have hzo : ¬ Occurs z (all x f) := by
+    simp only [Occurs]; intro o; cases o with
+    | inl o => exact hzx o
+    | inr o => exact hz o
+  have s2 : Thm Ax (imp (all x f) (all z (rn x z f))) :=
+    syl hC (vac_of_not_occurs hC z _ hzo) (all_mono hC z s1)
+  -- ∀z f[z/x] → f[z/x][x/z] = f
+  have hzb' : ¬ Bound z (rn x z f) := fun b => hzb ((bound_rn x z z f).mp b)
+  have hxb' : ¬ Bound x (rn x z f) := fun b => hx ((bound_rn x z x f).mp b)
+  have s3 : Thm Ax (imp (all z (rn x z f)) (rn z x (rn x z f))) := spec hC (Ne.symm hzx) hzb' hxb'
+  rw [rn_rn_fresh f hz] at s3
+  exact syl hC s2 s3
+
+/-- Alpha-renaming of a binder to a fresh label, forward direction. -/
+theorem alpha_fwd {x y : Nat} (hxy : y ≠ x) {f : NF} (hx : ¬ Bound x f) (hy : ¬ Occurs y f) :
+    Thm Ax (imp (all x f) (all y (rn x y f))) := by
+  have hyb : ¬ Bound y f := fun b => hy (bound_occurs b)
+  have hyo : ¬ Occurs y (all x f) := by
+    simp only [Occurs]; intro o; cases o with
+    | inl o => exact hxy o
+    | inr o => exact hy o
+  exact syl hC (vac_of_not_occurs hC y _ hyo) (all_mono hC y (spec hC hxy hx hyb))
+
+/-- Alpha-renaming of a binder to a fresh label, backward direction. -/
+theorem alpha_bwd {x y : Nat} (hxy : y ≠ x) {f : NF} (hx : ¬ Bound x f) (hy : ¬ Occurs y f) :
+    Thm Ax (imp (all y (rn x y f)) (all x f)) := by
+  have hyb : ¬ Bound y (rn x y f) := fun b => hy (bound_occurs ((bound_rn x y y f).mp b))
+  have hxb : ¬ Bound x (rn x y f) := fun b => hx ((bound_rn x y x f).mp b)
+  have s : Thm Ax (imp (all y (rn x y f)) (rn y x (rn x y f))) := spec hC (Ne.symm hxy) hyb hxb
+  rw [rn_rn_fresh f hy] at s
+  have hxo : ¬ Occurs x (all y (rn x y f)) := by
+    simp only [Occurs]; intro o; cases o with
+    | inl o => exact hxy o.symm
+    | inr o => exact not_occurs_rn hxy f hx o
+  exact syl hC (vac_of_not_occurs hC x _ hxo) (all_mono hC x s)
+
+end Leibniz
+
+end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Tarski

+
+/-!
+First-order equality-free matrix adapters for composition of bisimulations.
+
+Every collection resource is obtained from the actual Form-indexed GIC schema.
+The definitions preserve input/output slots and arbitrary parameter values.
+This is an interpretation layer, not a coded proof compiler or TM endpoint.
+-/
+
+namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.CompositionModel

+open DeepPositiveClosure

+universe u
+variable {V : Type u}
+
+def unionChoiceForm : Form :=
+  fAnd (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 3) (fMem 1 0))) (sameForm 1 0)
+
+theorem equalityFree_unionChoiceForm : EqualityFree unionChoiceForm := by
+  exact ⟨⟨True.intro, True.intro⟩, equalityFree_sameForm 1 0⟩
+
+theorem union_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) (family : V) :
+    CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family) := by
+  apply instance_of_matrix mem hModel unionChoiceForm equalityFree_unionChoiceForm
+    (fun _ => family) _
+  intro x y
+  exact and_congr Iff.rfl (sat_sameForm mem _ 1 0)
+
+def fiberChoiceForm : Form :=
+  fAnd (fMem 0 2) (fEx (fEx (fEx (fAnd (orderedPairForm 2 1 6)
+    (fAnd (orderedPairForm 1 0 3) (orderedPairForm 2 0 4))))))
+
+theorem equalityFree_fiberChoiceForm : EqualityFree fiberChoiceForm := by
+  exact ⟨True.intro, ⟨equalityFree_orderedPairForm 2 1 6,

+    (transContainers_of_containers ((sat_containerForm mem (fun _ => witness)).mp (h.1 _)))
+    (pairs_of_model mem witness h) (union_instance mem h.2)
+    (match_instance mem h.2) (backMatch_instance mem h.2)
+    (eqv_refl_of_model mem witness h)
+    (fun _ _ hxy => eqv_symm_of_model mem witness h hxy) x y hMembers
+
+#print axioms eqv_trans_of_model
+#print axioms eqv_extensionality_of_model
+
+end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.CompositionModel

+import BusyBeaver.ZFC.KLowerTag
+import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileComposition
+import BusyBeaver.ZFC.KQHyp
+
+/-!
+Coded bisimilarity on the tagged domain (Elliot Glazer's `KQuot`, `KQuotSym`, `KQuotTrans`,
+`KQuotExt`), from the repository's profile lemmas.
+
+The tagged domain has equality-free collection for every formula (`tag_gic`, from
+`tag_collection`), transitive containers and exact pairs. That is all the profile lemmas need:
+reflexivity (`bisim_refl_of_collection`), symmetry (`eqv_symm_of_instances`), and, through the
+transitive-container lemmas of `ProfileComposition`, transitivity and extensionality of `Eqv`.
+-/
+
+namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KLower
+
+open Form Profile ProfilePairs ProfileCollection ProfileComposition ProfileSyntax ProfileModel
+open CompositionModel DeepPositiveClosure ProfileComposition
+
+universe u
+variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}
+
+section Eqv
+
+variable (hs : FormSeed mem) (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x) {t : V} (ht : ∀ z, ¬ mem z t)
+include hs hirr ht
+
+theorem tag_gic : ModelsGIC (tmem mem t) := by
+  intro φ _ env
+  rw [sat_gicForm]
+  intro a
+  obtain ⟨b, h1, h2⟩ := tag_collection hs hirr ht (rename swap01 φ) env a
+  have hsw : ∀ x y, Sat (tmem mem t) (scons y (scons x env)) (rename swap01 φ) ↔
+      MatrixRelation (tmem mem t) φ env x y := fun x y =>
+    Sat_rename_ext _ _ _ _ fun n => by rcases n with _ | _ | n <;> rfl
+  refine ⟨b, fun y hy => ?_, fun x hx ⟨y, hy⟩ => ?_⟩
+  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h1 y hy
+    exact ⟨x, (hsw x y).mp hx⟩
+  · obtain ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ := h2 x hx ⟨y, (hsw x y).mpr hy⟩
+    exact ⟨z, hz, (hsw x z).mp hxz⟩
+
+theorem tag_tc : TransContainers (tmem mem t) := fun a => by
+  obtain ⟨v, hav, hv⟩ := tag_transitive hs hirr ht a
+  exact ⟨v, hav, fun y hy z hz => hv y hy z hz⟩
+
+theorem tag_pairs : ∀ a b : Tag mem t, ∃ p, Pair (tmem mem t) p a b := fun a b => by
+  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := tag_pair hs hirr ht a b
+  refine ⟨p, fun z => ⟨fun ⟨w, hw, hzw⟩ => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩⟩
+  · rcases (hp w).mp hw with rfl | rfl
+    · exact Or.inl hzw
+    · exact Or.inr hzw
+  · rcases h with h | h
+    · exact ⟨a, (hp a).mpr (Or.inl rfl), h⟩
+    · exact ⟨b, (hp b).mpr (Or.inr rfl), h⟩
+
+theorem tag_codes : ∀ x y : Tag mem t, ∃ c, OrderedPair (tmem mem t) x y c :=
+  orderedPairs_of_pairs _ (tag_pairs hs hirr ht)
+
+theorem tag_refl (x : Tag mem t) : Eqv (tmem mem t) x x := by
+  obtain ⟨d, hx, hd⟩ := tag_tc hs hirr ht x
+  exact bisim_refl_of_collection _ x d hx hd (tag_codes hs hirr ht)
+    (diagonal_instance _ (tag_gic hs hirr ht) d)
+
+theorem tag_symm {x y : Tag mem t} (h : Eqv (tmem mem t) x y) : Eqv (tmem mem t) y x :=
+  eqv_symm_of_instances _ (tag_codes hs hirr ht) (reverse_instance _ (tag_gic hs hirr ht)) h
+
+theorem tag_trans {x y z : Tag mem t} (h1 : Eqv (tmem mem t) x y) (h2 : Eqv (tmem mem t) y z) :
+    Eqv (tmem mem t) x z :=
+  eqv_trans_of_instances _ (tag_tc hs hirr ht) (tag_codes hs hirr ht)
+    (fun r2 d => fiber_instance _ (tag_gic hs hirr ht) r2 d)
+    (fun r1 r2 => composition_instance _ (tag_gic hs hirr ht) r1 r2)
+    (fun f => union_instance _ (tag_gic hs hirr ht) f) h1 h2
+
+theorem tag_ext (x y : Tag mem t) (h : ∀ z, Member (tmem mem t) z x ↔ Member (tmem mem t) z y) :
+    Eqv (tmem mem t) x y :=
+  eqv_extensionality_of_instances _ (tag_tc hs hirr ht) (tag_pairs hs hirr ht)
+    (fun f => union_instance _ (tag_gic hs hirr ht) f)
+    (fun a b => match_instance _ (tag_gic hs hirr ht) a b)
+    (fun a b => backMatch_instance _ (tag_gic hs hirr ht) a b)
+    (tag_refl hs hirr ht) (fun _ _ h => tag_symm hs hirr ht h) x y h
+
+/-! ## Interpreted membership respects `Eqv` -/
+
+theorem member_left {x x' y : Tag mem t} (hxx' : Eqv (tmem mem t) x x')
+    (h : Member (tmem mem t) x y) : Member (tmem mem t) x' y := by
+  obtain ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ := h
+  exact ⟨z, hz, tag_trans hs hirr ht (tag_symm hs hirr ht hxx') hxz⟩
+
+theorem member_right {x y y' : Tag mem t} (hyy' : Eqv (tmem mem t) y y')
+    (h : Member (tmem mem t) x y) : Member (tmem mem t) x y' := by
+  obtain ⟨r, hr, hEdge⟩ := hyy'
+  obtain ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ := h
+  obtain ⟨z', hz', hzz'⟩ := (hr y y' hEdge).1 z hz
+  exact ⟨z', hz', tag_trans hs hirr ht hxz ⟨r, hr, hzz'⟩⟩
+
+theorem member_raw {x y : Tag mem t} (h : tmem mem t x y) : Member (tmem mem t) x y :=
+  ⟨x, h, tag_refl hs hirr ht x⟩
+
+end Eqv
+
+end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KLower

+import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileCollection
+
+/-!
+Composition of equality-free profile-coded bisimulations.
+
+Two named GIC templates collect one composition fiber per source code;
+a third forms a union up to raw profiles. This proves exact composition
+at the represented App relation, without raw Separation, profile congruence,
+literal representative selection or closure for arbitrary semantic relations.
+These are semantic per-instance lemmas; first-order syntax adapters and
+whole-theory/machine calibration are separate obligations.
+-/
+
+namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileComposition
+
+open Profile ProfilePairs ProfileCollection
+
+universe u
+variable {V : Type u}
+
+/-- Every set lies in a transitive set: the half of `Containers` that the edge lemmas read.
+(The tagged domain of the lower chain has these but no literal power containers.) -/
+def TransContainers (mem : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
+  ∀ a, ∃ v, mem a v ∧ PositiveClosure.Transitive mem v
+
+theorem transContainers_of_containers {mem : V → V → Prop} (h : Containers mem) :
+    TransContainers mem :=
+  fun a => let ⟨v, hav, ht, _⟩ := h a; ⟨v, hav, ht⟩
+
+theorem orderedPair_code_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {a b c d : V}
+    (hcd : Same mem c d) (hc : OrderedPair mem a b c) : OrderedPair mem a b d := by
+  obtain ⟨s, p, hs, hp, hOuter⟩ := hc
+  exact ⟨s, p, hs, hp, pair_object_congr mem hcd hOuter⟩
+
+theorem app_object_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {r s : V}
+    (hrs : Same mem r s) (a b : V) : App mem r a b ↔ App mem s a b := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hab⟩
+    exact ⟨c, (hrs c).mp hc, hab⟩
+  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hab⟩
+    exact ⟨c, (hrs c).mpr hc, hab⟩
+
+def UnionChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (family x y : V) : Prop :=
+  (∃ r, mem r family ∧ mem x r) ∧ Same mem y x
+
+/-- Approximate raw Union is exact at the represented edge relation. -/
+theorem union_edges_of_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (family : V)
+    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
+    (hCollect : CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family)) :
+    ∃ s, ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ r, mem r family ∧ App mem r a b := by
+  obtain ⟨domain, hFamily, hTrans⟩ := hContainers family
+  obtain ⟨s, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hCollect domain
+  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
+  intro a b
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨c, hcs, hcode⟩
+    obtain ⟨d, ⟨r, hrFamily, hdr⟩, hcd⟩ := hSupport c hcs
+    exact ⟨r, hrFamily, d, hdr, orderedPair_code_congr mem hcd hcode⟩
+  · rintro ⟨r, hrFamily, d, hdr, hcode⟩
+    have hdDomain : mem d domain := hTrans r (hTrans family hFamily r hrFamily) d hdr
+    obtain ⟨c, hcs, _, hcd⟩ := hCover d hdDomain
+      ⟨d, ⟨r, hrFamily, hdr⟩, same_refl mem d⟩
+    exact ⟨c, hcs, orderedPair_code_congr mem (same_symm mem hcd) hcode⟩
+
+def FiberChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (r2 d c e : V) : Prop :=
+  mem c r2 ∧ ∃ s t u, OrderedPair mem s t d ∧
+    OrderedPair mem t u c ∧ OrderedPair mem s u e
+
+def FiberProfile (mem : V → V → Prop) (r2 d s : V) : Prop :=
+  ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ t, OrderedPair mem a t d ∧ App mem r2 t b
+
+/-- GIC over the second relation collects all edges composable with this code. -/
+theorem fiber_of_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (r2 d : V)
+    (hCodes : ∀ a b, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem a b c)
+    (hCollect : CollectionInstance mem (FiberChoice mem r2 d)) :
+    ∃ s, FiberProfile mem r2 d s := by
+  obtain ⟨s, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hCollect r2
+  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
+  intro a b
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨e, hes, hab⟩
+    obtain ⟨c, hcr2, p, q, u, hpq, hqu, hpu⟩ := hSupport e hes
+    obtain ⟨hap, hbu⟩ := orderedPair_injective mem hab hpu
+    refine ⟨q, orderedPair_endpoint_congr mem (same_symm mem hap) (same_refl mem q) hpq, ?_⟩
+    exact app_congr mem (same_refl mem q) (same_symm mem hbu) ⟨c, hcr2, hqu⟩
+  · rintro ⟨t, hat, c, hcr2, htb⟩
+    obtain ⟨e, hae⟩ := hCodes a b
+    obtain ⟨f, hfs, _, p, q, u, hpq, hqu, hpu⟩ :=
+      hCover c hcr2 ⟨e, hcr2, a, t, b, hat, htb, hae⟩
+    obtain ⟨hap, _⟩ := orderedPair_injective mem hat hpq
+    obtain ⟨_, hbu⟩ := orderedPair_injective mem htb hqu
+    exact ⟨f, hfs, orderedPair_endpoint_congr mem
+      (same_symm mem hap) (same_symm mem hbu) hpu⟩
+
+def CompositionChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (r1 r2 d s : V) : Prop :=
+  mem d r1 ∧ FiberProfile mem r2 d s
+
+/-- Two GIC layers plus the named approximate-union instance compose App exactly. -/
+theorem composition_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop) (r1 r2 : V)
+    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
+    (hCodes : ∀ a b, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem a b c)
+    (hFibers : ∀ d, CollectionInstance mem (FiberChoice mem r2 d))
+    (hComposition : CollectionInstance mem (CompositionChoice mem r1 r2))
+    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family)) :
+    ∃ s, ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ t, App mem r1 a t ∧ App mem r2 t b := by
+  obtain ⟨family, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hComposition r1
+  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := union_edges_of_instance mem family hContainers (hUnions family)
+  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
+  intro a b
+  constructor
+  · intro hab
+    obtain ⟨fiber, hfFamily, habFiber⟩ := (hs a b).mp hab
+    obtain ⟨d, hdr1, hFiber⟩ := hSupport fiber hfFamily
+    obtain ⟨t, hat, htb⟩ := (hFiber a b).mp habFiber
+    exact ⟨t, ⟨d, hdr1, hat⟩, htb⟩
+  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨d, hdr1, hat⟩, htb⟩
+    obtain ⟨fiber, hFiber⟩ := fiber_of_instance mem r2 d hCodes (hFibers d)
+    obtain ⟨selected, hSelected, _, hSelectedFiber⟩ :=
+      hCover d hdr1 ⟨fiber, hdr1, hFiber⟩
+    apply (hs a b).mpr
+    exact ⟨selected, hSelected, (hSelectedFiber a b).mpr ⟨t, hat, htb⟩⟩
+
+theorem bisim_composition (mem : V → V → Prop) {r1 r2 s : V}
+    (h1 : Bisim mem r1) (h2 : Bisim mem r2)
+    (hComp : ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ t, App mem r1 a t ∧ App mem r2 t b) :
+    Bisim mem s := by
+  intro a b hab
+  obtain ⟨t, hat, htb⟩ := (hComp a b).mp hab
+  obtain ⟨hF1, hB1⟩ := h1 a t hat
+  obtain ⟨hF2, hB2⟩ := h2 t b htb
+  constructor
+  · intro x hx
+    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hF1 x hx
+    obtain ⟨z, hz, hyz⟩ := hF2 y hy
+    exact ⟨z, hz, (hComp x z).mpr ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩⟩
+  · intro z hz
+    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := hB2 z hz
+    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hB1 y hy
+    exact ⟨x, hx, (hComp x z).mpr ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩⟩
+
+/-- Bisimulation transitivity from the three fixed collection-template families. -/
+theorem eqv_trans_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop)
+    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
+    (hCodes : ∀ a b, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem a b c)
+    (hFibers : ∀ r2 d, CollectionInstance mem (FiberChoice mem r2 d))
+    (hCompositions : ∀ r1 r2, CollectionInstance mem (CompositionChoice mem r1 r2))
+    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family))
+    {x y z : V} (hxy : Eqv mem x y) (hyz : Eqv mem y z) : Eqv mem x z := by
+  obtain ⟨r1, h1, hxy⟩ := hxy
+  obtain ⟨r2, h2, hyz⟩ := hyz
+  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := composition_of_instances mem r1 r2 hContainers hCodes
+    (hFibers r2) (hCompositions r1 r2) hUnions
+  exact ⟨s, bisim_composition mem h1 h2 hs, (hs x z).mpr ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩⟩
+
+theorem join_edges_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop) (r1 r2 : V)
+    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
+    (hPairs : ∀ a b, ∃ p, Pair mem p a b)
+    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family)) :
+    ∃ s, ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ App mem r1 a b ∨ App mem r2 a b := by
+  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hPairs r1 r2
+  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := union_edges_of_instance mem p hContainers (hUnions p)
+  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
+  intro a b
+  constructor
+  · intro hab
+    obtain ⟨r, hrp, hrab⟩ := (hs a b).mp hab
+    rcases (hp r).mp ⟨r, hrp, same_refl mem r⟩ with hr1 | hr2
+    · exact Or.inl ((app_object_congr mem hr1 a b).mp hrab)
+    · exact Or.inr ((app_object_congr mem hr2 a b).mp hrab)
+  · intro hab
+    rcases hab with h1 | h2
+    · obtain ⟨r, hrp, hr1⟩ := (hp r1).mpr (Or.inl (same_refl mem r1))
+      exact (hs a b).mpr ⟨r, hrp, (app_object_congr mem hr1 a b).mp h1⟩
+    · obtain ⟨r, hrp, hr2⟩ := (hp r2).mpr (Or.inr (same_refl mem r2))
+      exact (hs a b).mpr ⟨r, hrp, (app_object_congr mem hr2 a b).mp h2⟩
+
+theorem singleton_edges (mem : V → V → Prop) (k p : V) (hp : Pair mem p k k) :
+    ∀ a b, App mem p a b ↔ OrderedPair mem a b k := by
+  intro a b
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨c, hcp, hab⟩
+    have hck : Same mem c k := ((hp c).mp ⟨c, hcp, same_refl mem c⟩).elim id id
+    exact orderedPair_code_congr mem hck hab
+  · intro hab
+    obtain ⟨c, hcp, hkc⟩ := (hp k).mpr (Or.inl (same_refl mem k))
+    exact ⟨c, hcp, orderedPair_code_congr mem hkc hab⟩
+
+theorem bisim_union_edges (mem : V → V → Prop) (family s : V)
+    (hFamily : ∀ r, mem r family → Bisim mem r)
+    (hUnion : ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ r, mem r family ∧ App mem r a b) :
+    Bisim mem s := by
+  intro a b hab
+  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrab⟩ := (hUnion a b).mp hab
+  obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := hFamily r hr a b hrab
+  constructor
+  · intro x hx
+    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hForth x hx
+    exact ⟨y, hy, (hUnion x y).mpr ⟨r, hr, hxy⟩⟩
+  · intro y hy
+    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hBack y hy
+    exact ⟨x, hx, (hUnion x y).mpr ⟨r, hr, hxy⟩⟩
+
+theorem bisim_join_edges (mem : V → V → Prop) {r1 r2 s : V}
+    (h1 : Bisim mem r1) (h2 : Bisim mem r2)
+    (hJoin : ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ App mem r1 a b ∨ App mem r2 a b) :
+    Bisim mem s := by
+  intro a b hab
+  rcases (hJoin a b).mp hab with hab1 | hab2
+  · obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := h1 a b hab1
+    constructor
+    · intro x hx
+      obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hForth x hx
+      exact ⟨y, hy, (hJoin x y).mpr (Or.inl hxy)⟩
+    · intro y hy
+      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hBack y hy
+      exact ⟨x, hx, (hJoin x y).mpr (Or.inl hxy)⟩
+  · obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := h2 a b hab2
+    constructor
+    · intro x hx
+      obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hForth x hx
+      exact ⟨y, hy, (hJoin x y).mpr (Or.inr hxy)⟩
+    · intro y hy
+      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hBack y hy
+      exact ⟨x, hx, (hJoin x y).mpr (Or.inr hxy)⟩
+
+def MatchChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (x y a r : V) : Prop :=
+  mem a x ∧ ∃ b, mem b y ∧ Bisim mem r ∧ App mem r a b
+
+def BackMatchChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (x y b r : V) : Prop :=
+  mem b y ∧ ∃ a, mem a x ∧ Bisim mem r ∧ App mem r a b
+
+/-- Collect entire forward and backward matching bisimulations, then adjoin the root edge. -/
+theorem eqv_matching_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop) (x y : V)
+    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
+    (hPairs : ∀ a b, ∃ p, Pair mem p a b)
+    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family))
+    (hForwardCollection : CollectionInstance mem (MatchChoice mem x y))
+    (hBackCollection : CollectionInstance mem (BackMatchChoice mem x y))
+    (hForward : ∀ a, mem a x → ∃ b, mem b y ∧ Eqv mem a b)
+    (hBack : ∀ b, mem b y → ∃ a, mem a x ∧ Eqv mem a b) : Eqv mem x y := by
+  obtain ⟨ff, hSupportF, hCoverF⟩ := hForwardCollection x
+  obtain ⟨bf, hSupportB, hCoverB⟩ := hBackCollection y
+  obtain ⟨fr, hUnionF⟩ := union_edges_of_instance mem ff hContainers (hUnions ff)
+  obtain ⟨br, hUnionB⟩ := union_edges_of_instance mem bf hContainers (hUnions bf)
+  have hBisF : Bisim mem fr := by
+    apply bisim_union_edges mem ff fr ?_ hUnionF
+    intro r hr
+    obtain ⟨a, _, b, _, hBis, _⟩ := hSupportF r hr
+    exact hBis
+  have hBisB : Bisim mem br := by
+    apply bisim_union_edges mem bf br ?_ hUnionB
+    intro r hr
+    obtain ⟨b, _, a, _, hBis, _⟩ := hSupportB r hr
+    exact hBis
+  obtain ⟨joined, hJoin⟩ := join_edges_of_instances mem fr br hContainers hPairs hUnions
+  have hBisJoined : Bisim mem joined := bisim_join_edges mem hBisF hBisB hJoin
+  have hRootF : ∀ a, mem a x → ∃ b, mem b y ∧ App mem joined a b := by
+    intro a ha
+    obtain ⟨b, hb, r, hr, hab⟩ := hForward a ha
+    obtain ⟨selected, hSelected, _, b', hb', _, hab'⟩ :=
+      hCoverF a ha ⟨r, ha, b, hb, hr, hab⟩
+    exact ⟨b', hb', (hJoin a b').mpr (Or.inl
+      ((hUnionF a b').mpr ⟨selected, hSelected, hab'⟩))⟩
+  have hRootB : ∀ b, mem b y → ∃ a, mem a x ∧ App mem joined a b := by
+    intro b hb
+    obtain ⟨a, ha, r, hr, hab⟩ := hBack b hb
+    obtain ⟨selected, hSelected, _, a', ha', _, hab'⟩ :=
+      hCoverB b hb ⟨r, hb, a, ha, hr, hab⟩
+    exact ⟨a', ha', (hJoin a' b).mpr (Or.inr
+      ((hUnionB a' b).mpr ⟨selected, hSelected, hab'⟩))⟩
+  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := orderedPairs_of_pairs mem hPairs x y
+  obtain ⟨single, hSingle⟩ := hPairs k k
+  have hSingleEdges := singleton_edges mem k single hSingle
+  obtain ⟨r, hRootJoin⟩ :=
+    join_edges_of_instances mem joined single hContainers hPairs hUnions

+    · intro v hv
+      obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := hBack v hv

+    (hPairs : ∀ a b, ∃ p, Pair mem p a b)
+    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family))
+    (hForwardCollection : ∀ x y, CollectionInstance mem (MatchChoice mem x y))
+    (hBackCollection : ∀ x y, CollectionInstance mem (BackMatchChoice mem x y))
+    (hRefl : ∀ x, Eqv mem x x)

+    (hForwardCollection x y) (hBackCollection x y)

+  · intro b hb
+    obtain ⟨a, ha, hba⟩ := (hMembers b).mpr ⟨b, hb, hRefl b⟩
+    exact ⟨a, ha, hSymm b a hba⟩
+
+#print axioms union_edges_of_instance
+#print axioms composition_of_instances
+#print axioms eqv_trans_of_instances
+#print axioms eqv_extensionality_of_instances

+and it replaces equality vacuity by the canonical helper

+import BusyBeaver.ZFC.InternalOrd
+
+/-!
+The cumulative hierarchy inside an arbitrary model of ZF with Foundation.
+
+`V_β = {z | z ⊆ V_γ for some γ ∈ β}` is built by transfinite recursion on
+the internal ordinals, for any definable relation `R z T` in place of `z ⊆ T`
+(`TransRec` takes `z ∈ G T`). An *approximation* on an ordinal `d` is a set of
+Kuratowski pairs `⟨β, S⟩`, one for each `β ∈ d`, obeying that recursion
+(`RApprox`). Approximations agree where both are defined (`rapprox_unique`,
+by ordinal induction), every ordinal carries one (`rapprox_exists`: extend
+by one stage, then glue the approximations of the successors below by
+Replacement), and the stages are read off them (`RStage`; `IsV` for `R = Sub`).
+-/
+
+namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.InternalRank
+
+open NamedZF NForm InternalOrd
+
+universe u
+variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}
+
+/-! ## Formulas for subsets, pairs and power sets -/
+
+/-- `z ⊆ t`. -/
+def subF (z t : Nat) : NForm := .all (z + t + 1) (.imp (.mem (z + t + 1) z) (.mem (z + t + 1) t))
+
+theorem nsat_subF (ρ : Nat → V) (z t : Nat) : NSat mem ρ (subF z t) ↔ Sub mem (ρ z) (ρ t) := by
+  simp (disch := omega) only [subF, NSat, upd_same, upd_other]
+  rfl
+
+/-- `s = {x}`. -/
+def singF (s x : Nat) : NForm := .all (s + x + 1) ((NForm.mem (s + x + 1) s).iff (.eq (s + x + 1) x))
+
+/-- `p = {x, y}`. -/
+def upairF (p x y : Nat) : NForm :=
+  .all (p + x + y + 1)
+    ((NForm.mem (p + x + y + 1) p).iff (.or (.eq (p + x + y + 1) x) (.eq (p + x + y + 1) y)))
+
+/-- `p = ⟨x, y⟩ = {{x}, {x, y}}`. -/
+def kpairF (p x y : Nat) : NForm :=
+  .all (p + x + y + 1)
+    ((NForm.mem (p + x + y + 1) p).iff (.or (singF (p + x + y + 1) x) (upairF (p + x + y + 1) x y)))
+
+/-- `⟨x, y⟩ ∈ f`. -/
+def pmemF (f x y : Nat) : NForm :=
+  .ex (f + x + y + 1) (.and (kpairF (f + x + y + 1) x y) (.mem (f + x + y + 1) f))
+
+/-- `y` is the power set of `t`. -/
+def powF (y t : Nat) : NForm := .all (y + t + 1) ((NForm.mem (y + t + 1) y).iff (subF (y + t + 1) t))
+
+section Pairs
+
+variable (H : ZFAxioms mem)
+
+theorem nsat_singF (ρ : Nat → V) (s x : Nat) : NSat mem ρ (singF s x) ↔ ρ s = vsingle H (ρ x) := by
+  simp (disch := omega) only [singF, NSat, nsat_iff, upd_same, upd_other]
+  constructor
+  · intro h; exact H.ext _ _ fun d => (h d).trans (vsingle_spec H _ d).symm
+  · intro h d; rw [h]; exact vsingle_spec H _ d
+
+theorem nsat_upairF (ρ : Nat → V) (p x y : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (upairF p x y) ↔ ρ p = vpair H (ρ x) (ρ y) := by
+  simp (disch := omega) only [upairF, NSat, nsat_iff, upd_same, upd_other]
+  constructor
+  · intro h; exact H.ext _ _ fun d => (h d).trans (vpair_spec H _ _ d).symm
+  · intro h d; rw [h]; exact vpair_spec H _ _ d
+
+theorem nsat_kpairF (ρ : Nat → V) (p x y : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (kpairF p x y) ↔ ρ p = kpair H (ρ x) (ρ y) := by
+  simp only [kpairF, NSat, nsat_iff, nsat_singF H, nsat_upairF H]
+  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
+  constructor
+  · intro h; exact H.ext _ _ fun d => (h d).trans (kpair_mem H _ _ d).symm
+  · intro h d; rw [h]; exact kpair_mem H _ _ d
+
+theorem nsat_pmemF (ρ : Nat → V) (f x y : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (pmemF f x y) ↔ mem (kpair H (ρ x) (ρ y)) (ρ f) := by
+  simp only [pmemF, NSat, nsat_kpairF H]
+  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨d, rfl, h⟩; exact h
+  · intro h; exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩
+
+theorem nsat_powF (ρ : Nat → V) (y t : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (powF y t) ↔ ∀ z, mem z (ρ y) ↔ Sub mem z (ρ t) := by
+  simp only [powF, NSat, nsat_iff, nsat_subF]
+  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
+
+end Pairs
+
+/-! ## Recursion along the ordinals
+
+The development is generic in the relation `R z T` ("`z` enters a stage from the earlier
+stage `T`"), named by a formula `rF`: `Sub` gives the cumulative hierarchy below, and
+`TransRec` takes `z ∈ G T` for a definable operation `G`. -/
+
+variable {R : V → V → Prop} {rF : Nat → Nat → NForm}
+
+/-- `rF` names `R`. -/
+abbrev RDef (mem : V → V → Prop) (R : V → V → Prop) (rF : Nat → Nat → NForm) : Prop :=
+  ∀ (ρ : Nat → V) (z t : Nat), NSat mem ρ (rF z t) ↔ R (ρ z) (ρ t)
+
+/-- Every class `{z | R z T}` is a set. -/
+abbrev RSets (mem : V → V → Prop) (R : V → V → Prop) : Prop := ∀ T, ∃ P, ∀ z, mem z P ↔ R z T
+
+/-- `y = {z | R z t}`. -/
+def classF (rF : Nat → Nat → NForm) (y t : Nat) : NForm :=
+  .all (y + t + 1) ((NForm.mem (y + t + 1) y).iff (rF (y + t + 1) t))
+
+theorem nsat_classF (hrF : RDef mem R rF) (ρ : Nat → V) (y t : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (classF rF y t) ↔ ∀ z, mem z (ρ y) ↔ R z (ρ t) := by
+  simp only [classF, NSat, nsat_iff, hrF]
+  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
+
+/-- `f` approximates the `R`-hierarchy on the ordinal `d`. -/
+def RApprox (H : ZFAxioms mem) (R : V → V → Prop) (f d : V) : Prop :=
+  (∀ p, mem p f → ∃ b S, mem b d ∧ p = kpair H b S) ∧
+  (∀ b, mem b d → ∃ S, mem (kpair H b S) f) ∧
+  (∀ b S S', mem (kpair H b S) f → mem (kpair H b S') f → S = S') ∧
+  (∀ b S, mem (kpair H b S) f →
+    ∀ z, mem z S ↔ ∃ c T, mem c b ∧ mem (kpair H c T) f ∧ R z T)
+
+/-- The named formula for `RApprox` (free names `f`, `d`). -/
+def rapproxF (rF : Nat → Nat → NForm) (f d : Nat) : NForm :=
+  let n := f + d + 1
+  -- every member is a pair with first coordinate in `d`
+  let c1 := NForm.all n (.imp (.mem n f) (.ex (n + 1) (.ex (n + 2)
+    (.and (.mem (n + 1) d) (kpairF n (n + 1) (n + 2))))))
+  -- every `b ∈ d` has a value
+  let c2 := NForm.all n (.imp (.mem n d) (.ex (n + 1) (pmemF f n (n + 1))))
+  -- values are unique
+  let c3 := NForm.all n (.all (n + 1) (.all (n + 2)
+    (.imp (.and (pmemF f n (n + 1)) (pmemF f n (n + 2))) (.eq (n + 1) (n + 2)))))
+  -- the recursion
+  let rhs := NForm.ex (n + 3) (.ex (n + 4) (.and (.mem (n + 3) n)
+    (.and (pmemF f (n + 3) (n + 4)) (rF (n + 2) (n + 4)))))
+  let c4 := NForm.all n (.all (n + 1) (.imp (pmemF f n (n + 1))
+    (.all (n + 2) ((NForm.mem (n + 2) (n + 1)).iff rhs))))
+  .and c1 (.and c2 (.and c3 c4))
+
+theorem nsat_rapproxF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hrF : RDef mem R rF) (ρ : Nat → V) (f d : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (rapproxF rF f d) ↔ RApprox H R (ρ f) (ρ d) := by
+  simp only [rapproxF, NSat, nsat_iff, nsat_kpairF H, nsat_pmemF H, hrF, and_imp]
+  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
+  rfl
+
+section Unique
+
+variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem)
+include H hR
+
+/-- Two approximations agree wherever both are defined. -/
+theorem rapprox_unique {f g d e : V} (hf : RApprox H R f d) (hg : RApprox H R g e)
+    (hd : Ord mem d) (he : Ord mem e) :
+    ∀ b, Ord mem b → mem b d → mem b e →
+      ∀ S S', mem (kpair H b S) f → mem (kpair H b S') g → S = S' := by
+  have key := ord_induction H hR
+    (fun b => mem b d → mem b e → ∀ S S', mem (kpair H b S) f → mem (kpair H b S') g → S = S')
+    (.imp (.mem 0 3) (.imp (.mem 0 4) (.all 5 (.all 6
+      (.imp (.and (pmemF 1 0 5) (pmemF 2 0 6)) (.eq 5 6))))))
+    (fun i => if i = 1 then f else if i = 2 then g else if i = 3 then d else e)
+    (fun x => by
+      simp only [NSat, nsat_pmemF H]
+      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
+      simp)
+    (fun a ha IH had hae S S' hS hS' => by
+      apply H.ext; intro z
+      rw [hf.2.2.2 a S hS z, hg.2.2.2 a S' hS' z]
+      constructor
+      · rintro ⟨c, T, hca, hcT, hzT⟩
+        have hcd : mem c d := hd.1 a had c hca
+        have hce : mem c e := he.1 a hae c hca
+        obtain ⟨T', hT'⟩ := hg.2.1 c hce
+        exact ⟨c, T', hca, hT', IH c hca hcd hce T T' hcT hT' ▸ hzT⟩
+      · rintro ⟨c, T', hca, hcT', hzT⟩
+        have hcd : mem c d := hd.1 a had c hca
+        have hce : mem c e := he.1 a hae c hca
+        obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hf.2.1 c hcd
+        exact ⟨c, T, hca, hT, (IH c hca hcd hce T T' hT hcT') ▸ hzT⟩)
+  exact key
+
+end Unique
+
+/-- `m = a ∪ {a}`. -/
+def succF (m a : Nat) : NForm :=
+  .all (m + a + 1) ((NForm.mem (m + a + 1) m).iff (.or (.mem (m + a + 1) a) (.eq (m + a + 1) a)))
+
+theorem nsat_succF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (m a : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (succF m a) ↔ ρ m = vsucc H (ρ a) := by
+  simp (disch := omega) only [succF, NSat, nsat_iff, upd_same, upd_other]
+  constructor
+  · intro h; exact H.ext _ _ fun d => (h d).trans (vsucc_spec H _ d).symm
+  · intro h d; rw [h]; exact vsucc_spec H _ d
+
+section Exists
+
+variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem)
+include H hR
+
+/-- Approximations on the same ordinal are equal. -/
+theorem rapprox_eq {f g d : V} (hf : RApprox H R f d) (hg : RApprox H R g d) (hd : Ord mem d) :
+    f = g := by
+  apply H.ext; intro p
+  constructor
+  · intro hp
+    obtain ⟨b, S, hb, rfl⟩ := hf.1 p hp
+    obtain ⟨S', hS'⟩ := hg.2.1 b hb
+    rwa [rapprox_unique H hR hf hg hd hd b (ord_of_mem hd hb) hb hb S S' hp hS']
+  · intro hp
+    obtain ⟨b, S, hb, rfl⟩ := hg.1 p hp
+    obtain ⟨S', hS'⟩ := hf.2.1 b hb
+    rwa [← rapprox_unique H hR hf hg hd hd b (ord_of_mem hd hb) hb hb S' S hS' hp]
+
+omit hR in
+/-- First coordinates of pairs in an approximation lie in its domain. -/
+theorem rapprox_dom {f d b S : V} (hf : RApprox H R f d) (h : mem (kpair H b S) f) : mem b d := by
+  obtain ⟨b', S', hb', he⟩ := hf.1 _ h
+  rw [(kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ he).1]; exact hb'
+
+omit hR in
+/-- The next stage `⋃ {{z | R z T} | ⟨c, T⟩ ∈ f}` exists. -/
+theorem rstage_exists (hrF : RDef mem R rF) (hS : RSets mem R) {f b : V} (hf : RApprox H R f b) :
+    ∃ S, ∀ z, mem z S ↔ ∃ c T, mem c b ∧ mem (kpair H c T) f ∧ R z T := by
+  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := repl_of H (fun p P => ∃ c T, p = kpair H c T ∧ ∀ z, mem z P ↔ R z T)
+    (.ex 2 (.ex 3 (.and (kpairF 1 2 3) (classF rF 0 3)))) (fun _ => f)
+    (fun x y => by
+      simp only [NSat, nsat_kpairF H, nsat_classF hrF]
+      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other])
+    (fun p P1 P2 ⟨c, T, hp, h1⟩ ⟨c', T', hp', h2⟩ => by
+      rw [hp] at hp'
+      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ hp'
+      exact H.ext _ _ fun z => (h1 z).trans (h2 z).symm) f
+  refine ⟨vunion H Q, fun z => ?_⟩
+  rw [vunion_spec H Q z]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨P, hzP, hPQ⟩
+    obtain ⟨p, hp, c, T, rfl, hPT⟩ := (hQ P).1 hPQ
+    exact ⟨c, T, rapprox_dom H hf hp, hp, (hPT z).1 hzP⟩
+  · rintro ⟨c, T, -, hcT, hzT⟩
+    obtain ⟨P, hPT⟩ := hS T
+    exact ⟨P, (hPT z).2 hzT, (hQ P).2 ⟨_, hcT, c, T, rfl, hPT⟩⟩
+
+/-- Extend an approximation on `b` by the stage `b`. -/
+theorem rapprox_extend {f b S : V} (hf : RApprox H R f b) (hb : Ord mem b)
+    (hS : ∀ z, mem z S ↔ ∃ c T, mem c b ∧ mem (kpair H c T) f ∧ R z T) :
+    RApprox H R (vcup H f (vsingle H (kpair H b S))) (vsucc H b) := by
+  have hg : ∀ p, mem p (vcup H f (vsingle H (kpair H b S))) ↔ mem p f ∨ p = kpair H b S := by
+    intro p; rw [vcup_spec H _ _ p, vsingle_spec H _ p]
+  -- no pair of `f` sits at `b`
+  have hnb : ∀ T, ¬ mem (kpair H b T) f := fun T h => mem_irrefl H hR b (rapprox_dom H hf h)
+  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro p hp
+    rcases (hg p).1 hp with hp | rfl
+    · obtain ⟨c, T, hc, rfl⟩ := hf.1 p hp
+      exact ⟨c, T, (vsucc_spec H b c).2 (Or.inl hc), rfl⟩
+    · exact ⟨b, S, vsucc_self H b, rfl⟩
+  · intro c hc
+    rcases (vsucc_spec H b c).1 hc with hc | rfl
+    · obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hf.2.1 c hc
+      exact ⟨T, (hg _).2 (Or.inl hT)⟩
+    · exact ⟨S, (hg _).2 (Or.inr rfl)⟩
+  · intro c S1 S2 h1 h2
+    rcases (hg _).1 h1 with e1 | e1 <;> rcases (hg _).1 h2 with e2 | e2
+    · exact hf.2.2.1 c S1 S2 e1 e2
+    · obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ e2; exact absurd e1 (hnb S1)
+    · obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ e1; exact absurd e2 (hnb S2)
+    · rw [(kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ e1).2, (kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ e2).2]
+  · intro c S1 h1 z
+    -- pairs of the extension below a stage of `f` are pairs of `f`
+    have back : ∀ x, mem x b → ∀ c' T, mem c' x → mem (kpair H c' T) (vcup H f (vsingle H (kpair H b S))) →
+        mem (kpair H c' T) f := by
+      intro x hx c' T hc' hT
+      rcases (hg _).1 hT with hT | hT
+      · exact hT
+      · obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ hT
+        exact absurd (hb.1 x hx c' hc') (mem_irrefl H hR c')
+    rcases (hg _).1 h1 with h1 | h1
+    · have hcb := rapprox_dom H hf h1
+      rw [hf.2.2.2 c S1 h1 z]
+      constructor
+      · rintro ⟨c', T, hc', hT, hz⟩; exact ⟨c', T, hc', (hg _).2 (Or.inl hT), hz⟩
+      · rintro ⟨c', T, hc', hT, hz⟩; exact ⟨c', T, hc', back c hcb c' T hc' hT, hz⟩
+    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ h1
+      rw [hS z]
+      constructor
+      · rintro ⟨c', T, hc', hT, hz⟩; exact ⟨c', T, hc', (hg _).2 (Or.inl hT), hz⟩
+      · rintro ⟨c', T, hc', hT, hz⟩
+        rcases (hg _).1 hT with hT | hT
+        · exact ⟨c', T, hc', hT, hz⟩
+        · obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ hT
+          exact absurd hc' (mem_irrefl H hR _)
+
+/-- Glue the approximations on the successors below `d`. -/
+theorem rapprox_glue (hrF : RDef mem R rF) {d : V} (hd : Ord mem d) (h : ∀ b, mem b d → ∃ g, RApprox H R g (vsucc H b)) :
+    ∃ F, RApprox H R F d := by
+  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := repl_of H (fun b g => Ord mem b ∧ RApprox H R g (vsucc H b))
+    (.and (ordF 1) (.ex 2 (.and (succF 2 1) (rapproxF rF 0 2)))) (fun _ => d)
+    (fun x y => by
+      simp only [NSat, nsat_ordF, nsat_succF H, nsat_rapproxF H hrF]
+      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
+      constructor
+      · rintro ⟨ho, m, rfl, hm⟩; exact ⟨ho, hm⟩
+      · rintro ⟨ho, hm⟩; exact ⟨ho, _, rfl, hm⟩)
+    (fun _ _ _ h1 h2 => rapprox_eq H hR h1.2 h2.2 (ord_succ H h1.1)) d
+  have hF : ∀ p, mem p (vunion H G) ↔
+      ∃ b g, mem b d ∧ RApprox H R g (vsucc H b) ∧ mem p g := by
+    intro p; rw [vunion_spec H G p]
+    constructor
+    · rintro ⟨g, hpg, hgG⟩
+      obtain ⟨b, hb, -, hg⟩ := (hG g).1 hgG
+      exact ⟨b, g, hb, hg, hpg⟩
+    · rintro ⟨b, g, hb, hg, hpg⟩
+      exact ⟨g, hpg, (hG g).2 ⟨b, hb, ord_of_mem hd hb, hg⟩⟩
+  have agree : ∀ b1 g1 b2 g2 c S1 S2, mem b1 d → RApprox H R g1 (vsucc H b1) → mem b2 d →
+      RApprox H R g2 (vsucc H b2) → mem (kpair H c S1) g1 → mem (kpair H c S2) g2 → S1 = S2 := by
+    intro b1 g1 b2 g2 c S1 S2 hb1 hg1 hb2 hg2 h1 h2
+    have hc1 := rapprox_dom H hg1 h1
+    have ho1 := ord_succ H (ord_of_mem hd hb1)
+    exact rapprox_unique H hR hg1 hg2 ho1 (ord_succ H (ord_of_mem hd hb2)) c
+      (ord_of_mem ho1 hc1) hc1 (rapprox_dom H hg2 h2) S1 S2 h1 h2
+  have succ_sub : ∀ b c, mem b d → mem c (vsucc H b) → mem c d := by
+    intro b c hb hc
+    rcases (vsucc_spec H b c).1 hc with hc | rfl
+    · exact hd.1 b hb c hc
+    · exact hb
+  refine ⟨vunion H G, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro p hp
+    obtain ⟨b, g, hb, hg, hpg⟩ := (hF p).1 hp
+    obtain ⟨c, S, hc, rfl⟩ := hg.1 p hpg
+    exact ⟨c, S, succ_sub b c hb hc, rfl⟩
+  · intro c hc
+    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h c hc
+    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hg.2.1 c (vsucc_self H c)
+    exact ⟨S, (hF _).2 ⟨c, g, hc, hg, hS⟩⟩
+  · intro c S1 S2 h1 h2
+    obtain ⟨b1, g1, hb1, hg1, h1⟩ := (hF _).1 h1
+    obtain ⟨b2, g2, hb2, hg2, h2⟩ := (hF _).1 h2
+    exact agree b1 g1 b2 g2 c S1 S2 hb1 hg1 hb2 hg2 h1 h2
+  · intro c S1 h1 z
+    obtain ⟨b1, g1, hb1, hg1, h1⟩ := (hF _).1 h1
+    rw [hg1.2.2.2 c S1 h1 z]
+    have hcs := rapprox_dom H hg1 h1
+    constructor
+    · rintro ⟨c', T, hc', hT, hz⟩
+      exact ⟨c', T, hc', (hF _).2 ⟨b1, g1, hb1, hg1, hT⟩, hz⟩
+    · rintro ⟨c', T, hc', hT, hz⟩
+      obtain ⟨b2, g2, hb2, hg2, hT⟩ := (hF _).1 hT
+      have hc's : mem c' (vsucc H b1) := (ord_succ H (ord_of_mem hd hb1)).1 c hcs c' hc'
+      obtain ⟨T1, hT1⟩ := hg1.2.1 c' hc's
+      refine ⟨c', T1, hc', hT1, ?_⟩
+      rwa [agree b1 g1 b2 g2 c' T1 T hb1 hg1 hb2 hg2 hT1 hT]
+
+/-- **Every ordinal carries an approximation of the hierarchy.** -/
+theorem rapprox_exists (hrF : RDef mem R rF) (hS : RSets mem R) :
+    ∀ d, Ord mem d → ∃ f, RApprox H R f d :=
+  ord_induction H hR (fun d => ∃ f, RApprox H R f d) (.ex 1 (rapproxF rF 1 0)) (fun _ => vempty H)
+    (fun x => by
+      simp only [NSat, nsat_rapproxF H hrF]
+      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other])
+    (fun d hd IH => rapprox_glue H hR hrF hd fun b hb => by
+      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := IH b hb
+      obtain ⟨S, hS'⟩ := rstage_exists H hrF hS hf
+      exact ⟨_, rapprox_extend H hR hf (ord_of_mem hd hb) hS'⟩)
+
+end Exists
+
+/-! ## The hierarchy -/
+
+/-- `S` is the stage `a` of the `R`-hierarchy. -/
+def RStage (H : ZFAxioms mem) (R : V → V → Prop) (a S : V) : Prop :=
+  ∃ f, RApprox H R f (vsucc H a) ∧ mem (kpair H a S) f
+
+/-- The named formula for `RStage` (free names `a`, `S`). -/
+def rstageF (rF : Nat → Nat → NForm) (a S : Nat) : NForm :=
+  let n := a + S + 1
+  .ex n (.and (.ex (n + 1) (.and (succF (n + 1) a) (rapproxF rF n (n + 1)))) (pmemF n a S))
+
+theorem nsat_rstageF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hrF : RDef mem R rF) (ρ : Nat → V) (a S : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (rstageF rF a S) ↔ RStage H R (ρ a) (ρ S) := by
+  simp only [rstageF, NSat, nsat_succF H, nsat_rapproxF H hrF, nsat_pmemF H]
+  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨f, ⟨m, rfl, hf⟩, h⟩; exact ⟨f, hf, h⟩
+  · rintro ⟨f, hf, h⟩; exact ⟨f, ⟨_, rfl, hf⟩, h⟩
+
+section Stages
+
+variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem)
+include H hR
+
+theorem rstage_exists' (hrF : RDef mem R rF) (hS : RSets mem R) {a : V} (ha : Ord mem a) :
+    ∃ S, RStage H R a S := by
+  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := rapprox_exists H hR hrF hS _ (ord_succ H ha)
+  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hf.2.1 a (vsucc_self H a)
+  exact ⟨S, f, hf, hS⟩
+
+theorem rstage_unique {a S S' : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (h : RStage H R a S) (h' : RStage H R a S') :
+    S = S' := by
+  obtain ⟨f, hf, hS⟩ := h
+  obtain ⟨g, hg, hS'⟩ := h'
+  have ho := ord_succ H ha
+  exact rapprox_unique H hR hf hg ho ho a ha (vsucc_self H a) (vsucc_self H a) S S' hS hS'
+
+/-- **The recursion equation:** `stage a = {z | R z (stage c) for some c ∈ a}`. -/
+theorem rstage_spec (hrF : RDef mem R rF) (hS : RSets mem R) {a S : V} (ha : Ord mem a)
+    (h : RStage H R a S) : ∀ z, mem z S ↔ ∃ c T, mem c a ∧ RStage H R c T ∧ R z T := by
+  obtain ⟨f, hf, hS0⟩ := h
+  have ho := ord_succ H ha
+  intro z
+  rw [hf.2.2.2 a S hS0 z]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨c, T, hc, hcT, hz⟩
+    have hoc := ord_of_mem ha hc
+    obtain ⟨T', g, hg, hcg⟩ := rstage_exists' H hR hrF hS hoc
+    have e : T = T' := rapprox_unique H hR hf hg ho (ord_succ H hoc) c hoc
+      ((vsucc_spec H a c).2 (Or.inl hc)) (vsucc_self H c) T T' hcT hcg
+    exact ⟨c, T, hc, ⟨g, hg, by rw [e]; exact hcg⟩, hz⟩
+  · rintro ⟨c, T, hc, ⟨g, hg, hcg⟩, hz⟩
+    have hoc := ord_of_mem ha hc
+    obtain ⟨T0, hT0⟩ := hf.2.1 c ((vsucc_spec H a c).2 (Or.inl hc))
+    have e : T0 = T := rapprox_unique H hR hf hg ho (ord_succ H hoc) c hoc
+      ((vsucc_spec H a c).2 (Or.inl hc)) (vsucc_self H c) T0 T hT0 hcg
+    exact ⟨c, T0, hc, hT0, by rw [e]; exact hz⟩
+
+/-- Stages grow along the ordinals. -/
+theorem rstage_mono (hrF : RDef mem R rF) (hS : RSets mem R) {a c S T : V} (ha : Ord mem a)
+    (hc : mem c a) (hT : RStage H R c T) (hSa : RStage H R a S) : Sub mem T S := by
+  intro z hz
+  obtain ⟨c', T', hc', hT', hzT'⟩ := (rstage_spec H hR hrF hS (ord_of_mem ha hc) hT z).1 hz
+  exact (rstage_spec H hR hrF hS ha hSa z).2 ⟨c', T', ha.1 c hc c' hc', hT', hzT'⟩
+
+end Stages
+
+/-! ## The cumulative hierarchy: `R = Sub` -/
+
+/-- `S = V_a`. -/
+def IsV (H : ZFAxioms mem) (a S : V) : Prop := RStage H (Sub mem) a S
+
+/-- The named formula for `IsV` (free names `a`, `S`). -/
+def isVF (a S : Nat) : NForm := rstageF subF a S
+
+theorem nsat_isVF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (a S : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (isVF a S) ↔ IsV H (ρ a) (ρ S) :=
+  nsat_rstageF H nsat_subF ρ a S
+
+section Hierarchy
+
+variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
+include H hR hP
+
+theorem isV_exists {a : V} (ha : Ord mem a) : ∃ S, IsV H a S := rstage_exists' H hR nsat_subF hP ha
+
+omit hP in
+theorem isV_unique {a S S' : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (h : IsV H a S) (h' : IsV H a S') : S = S' :=
+  rstage_unique H hR ha h h'
+
+/-- **The recursion equation:** `V_a = {z | z ⊆ V_c for some c ∈ a}`. -/
+theorem isV_spec {a S : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (h : IsV H a S) :
+    ∀ z, mem z S ↔ ∃ c T, mem c a ∧ IsV H c T ∧ Sub mem z T :=
+  rstage_spec H hR nsat_subF hP ha h
+
+theorem isV_mono {a c S T : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (hc : mem c a) (hT : IsV H c T)
+    (hS : IsV H a S) : Sub mem T S :=
+  rstage_mono H hR nsat_subF hP ha hc hT hS
+
+theorem isV_trans {a S : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (hS : IsV H a S) : Trans mem S := by
+  intro z hz w hw
+  obtain ⟨c, T, hc, hT, hzT⟩ := (isV_spec H hR hP ha hS z).1 hz
+  exact isV_mono H hR hP ha hc hT hS w (hzT w hw)
+
+end Hierarchy
+
+end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.InternalRank

+import BusyBeaver.ZFC.InternalRank
+
+/-!
+Transfinite recursion for a definable stage operation.
+
+Given an operation `G` on the sets of a model of ZF with Foundation whose graph
+is defined by a named formula, there is a unique hierarchy
+
+    stage a = ⋃ { G (stage c) | c ∈ a }
+
+along the internal ordinals. With `G = P` this is the cumulative hierarchy of
+`InternalRank`; with `G = Def` it will be Gödel's constructible hierarchy.
+
+It is `InternalRank`'s generic recursion with `R z T := z ∈ G T`: approximations
+are sets of Kuratowski pairs obeying the recursion; they agree where both are
+defined, extend by one stage, glue below every ordinal, and so exist;
+`IsStage` reads the hierarchy off them.
+-/
+
+namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.TransRec
+
+open NamedZF NForm InternalOrd InternalRank
+
+universe u
+variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}
+
+/-- A definable operation: `gF y x` defines `y = G x` (output name `y`, input name `x`). -/
+structure DefOp (mem : V → V → Prop) (G : V → V) where
+  gF : Nat → Nat → NForm
+  spec : ∀ (ρ : Nat → V) (y x : Nat), NSat mem ρ (gF y x) ↔ ρ y = G (ρ x)
+
+variable {G : V → V}
+
+/-- `z ∈ G t`, with a fresh witness name. -/
+def inGF (D : DefOp mem G) (z t : Nat) : NForm :=
+  .ex (z + t + 1) (.and (D.gF (z + t + 1) t) (.mem z (z + t + 1)))
+
+theorem nsat_inGF (D : DefOp mem G) (ρ : Nat → V) (z t : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (inGF D z t) ↔ mem (ρ z) (G (ρ t)) := by
+  simp only [inGF, NSat, D.spec]
+  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨d, rfl, h⟩; exact h
+  · intro h; exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩
+
+/-! ## The `G`-hierarchy: `InternalRank`'s recursion with `R z T := z ∈ G T` -/
+
+/-- `f` approximates the `G`-hierarchy on the ordinal `d`. -/
+def Approx (H : ZFAxioms mem) (G : V → V) (f d : V) : Prop := RApprox H (fun z T => mem z (G T)) f d
+
+/-- `S` is the stage `a` of the `G`-hierarchy. -/
+def IsStage (H : ZFAxioms mem) (G : V → V) (a S : V) : Prop := RStage H (fun z T => mem z (G T)) a S
+
+def isStageF (D : DefOp mem G) (a S : Nat) : NForm := rstageF (inGF D) a S
+
+theorem nsat_isStageF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (D : DefOp mem G) (ρ : Nat → V) (a S : Nat) :
+    NSat mem ρ (isStageF D a S) ↔ IsStage H G (ρ a) (ρ S) :=
+  nsat_rstageF H (nsat_inGF D) ρ a S
+
+/-- Every class `G T` is a set. -/
+theorem gSets : RSets mem (fun z T => mem z (G T)) := fun T => ⟨G T, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
+
+section Hierarchy
+
+variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem) (D : DefOp mem G)
+include H hR D
+
+theorem stage_exists' {a : V} (ha : Ord mem a) : ∃ S, IsStage H G a S :=
+  rstage_exists' H hR (nsat_inGF D) gSets ha
+
+omit D in
+theorem stage_unique {a S S' : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (h : IsStage H G a S) (h' : IsStage H G a S') :
+    S = S' := rstage_unique H hR ha h h'
+
+/-- **The recursion equation:** `stage a = ⋃ {G (stage c) | c ∈ a}`. -/
+theorem stage_spec {a S : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (h : IsStage H G a S) :
+    ∀ z, mem z S ↔ ∃ c T, mem c a ∧ IsStage H G c T ∧ mem z (G T) :=
+  rstage_spec H hR (nsat_inGF D) gSets ha h
+
+/-- Stages grow along the ordinals. -/
+theorem stage_mono {a c S T : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (hc : mem c a) (hT : IsStage H G c T)
+    (hS : IsStage H G a S) : Sub mem T S :=
+  rstage_mono H hR (nsat_inGF D) gSets ha hc hT hS
+
+end Hierarchy
+
+end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.TransRec
